note: THE HELPER REWARDS' AMOUNTS, read by tools/server/make-config.mts ALONE, which writes them into the game config as the rewards catalog's recipes (docs/vip.md). Never read by the game or the win checker: they learn what a reward gives from the config (the preview before, the receipt after; the creator, 2026-11-12: "never copy amounts from the config into code"). `kit`: once ever, at the end of board 1; `hard`: a hard or super campaign board's first win; `stamp`: a trip's last board's first win (instead of hard); `daily`: the daily puzzle's first win of the player's day, one helper by weekday, MONDAY FIRST (ISO 1..7); `vip.daily`: VIP's gift of each weekday, Monday first; `vip.welcome`: VIP's welcome, once per player, ever. Every reward but VIP's gifts has a base for everyone and a VIP bonus of the same again (`requires: holds_pass vip`); VIP's gifts are a bonus alone.
